name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: PMJJBY is a one-year renewable term-life-insurance scheme that provides cover for death due to any cause.
benefits: The official Department of Financial Services FAQ states that Rs. 2 lakh is payable on the subscriber's death due to any cause. The stated annual premium is Rs. 436 per subscriber, subject to current scheme terms.
eligibility: The official FAQ states that eligible participating bank or post-office account holders aged 18 to 50 may join, subject to scheme terms. Check the current terms with the participating institution before enrolling.
documents: The participating bank or post office can confirm the current consent, account, and identification requirements.
application_process: Enrol through a participating bank or post office account and provide the required auto-debit consent under the current scheme process.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Any bank or post office account holder aged 18 to 50 years
